title: Quantum Darwinism through apparatus-mediated environmental recording
summary: Quantum Darwinism explains classical objectivity through redundant environmental records of a system's pointer states. We show that these records can be established through an intermediate measurement apparatus without direct system--environment interactions. Using exact analytical solutions of quantum circuit models, we compare system monitoring with apparatus monitoring, where the environment interacts only with the apparatus.
